problems: Elenchus of PG 145 prints NO columns; every column is body-derived with the closing Ordo Rerum as cross-check, so no entry is 'agree'.
Syntagma (Continuatio): bodyCol 9 is inferred from Ordo (INITIUM LITTERAE M. 9) and adjacency to header 11|12, not read from a page number.
Carmina duo: only a title block with cross-reference to tom. CLVII col. 129 (Goar's notes to Codinus); entered as crossref; its own column (211 vs 213) not settled.
Metochitam: Ordo 384 vs body 381; body belief stated in the entry note.
Oratio de regis officiis: Ordo 'A41' garbled; body title block at 447, but a stray running head at 445 precedes it.
Ordo prints a Cramoisy dedicatory epistle to Richelieu (557); editorial, omitted by the Elenchus, so not entered.

The Elenchus says Historiae libri I-VII; the Ordo and body print the full title as libri XVIII (Tomus prior holds books I-VII). Books II-VII heads not individually body-confirmed (parts are Ordo-only per the brief); Liber III and IV title blocks are missing/garbled in the OCR.
Ordo for Syntagma lists only chapter-level matter by letter, no top-level pieces, so no parts built.
Elenchus editor names/years ('Laur. Noemanni, Upsal. 1003', 'Laur. Nini') kept as the OCR reads them; not verified.
